title: ChatHealthy Pipeline Config
description: Per-environment configuration for the ChatHealthy data pipeline. Replaces the chathealthyfrontend.pipeline.config Mongo document; source of truth is brain/machine_artifacts/content/pipeline_config.json.

dataset_versions.description: Registry of every dataset the pipeline touches. Four entry shapes: Class A (independent source with its own fetch), Class B-owner (bundled source that owns the archive fetch), Class B-extractor (bundled source that reuses another entry's fetch), Class C (pipeline-derived collection with no source). Runtime appends _v_{data_version} to staging_name and public_data_name; those base names MUST NOT carry a version suffix here.

source_name.description: Friendly identifier. Lowercase snake_case. Uniqueness within the array is a runtime concern until the Phase-2 registry lands.

fetch.description: Provenance of the dataset. Present when this entry owns the download. Absent for Class B-extractor entries (they reuse the archive fetched by another bundled entry) and for Class C derived entries.

source_url.description: Direct URL as a plain string, or an object with page_url + instructions when the URL is discovered by the AI-agent url-discovery worker.

fetch_spec.description: Prefabricated, model-free declarative fetch parameterization: exactly the data-fetch agent's typed find input, discriminated by `mode`. Replaces the AI url-discovery object so a deterministic source needs no model and the worker manufactures nothing.

extract.description: Optional. When present the fetch does not store the downloaded archive whole; it extracts exactly one member and stores that member's bytes. member_path is an ordered descent: every element but the last names a nested archive to open, the last names the member to store. Each element globs its archive case-insensitively and MUST match exactly one entry (ambiguity is fatal). This lands a single table that lives inside a (possibly nested) zip -- e.g. the Medicare Coverage DB, whose CSVs sit inside all_article_csv.zip inside all_article.zip -- as its own blob. Mirrors the data-fetch agent's typed ZipExtract input.

mode.description: Archive kind. Only 'zip' is implemented (nested zips supported); tar is reserved and not implemented.

member_path.description: Ordered descent to the one member to store. Each string globs one entry in the current archive (case-insensitive, exactly one match); every element but the last opens a nested archive and the last is the stored member. Example: ["all_article_csv.zip", "article_x_icd10_covered.csv"].

source_encoding.description: Optional. When present the fetch stream-transcodes the stored TEXT from this charset to UTF-8, so the stored blob is UTF-8 and charset is never a downstream ETL concern (absent means the published bytes are stored as-is). Text sources only: permitted (by the entry-level conditional) solely when file_format is a plain-text format (csv, tsv, pipe_delimited); binary artifacts (xlsx, any zip_*) never carry it, and the fetcher refuses by magic-byte signature if ever pointed at binary. Applies to the plain download or the extracted member, never to a raw archive.

bundled_with.description: Archive identifier shared by two or more entries whose data lives in the same downloaded archive. Present on Class B-owner and Class B-extractor entries.

archive_member.description: Substring naming the entry's data file inside its archive. Required whenever bundled_with is present (Class B). Also permitted on a Class A self-fetched entry whose fetched archive carries more than one member, to name which member is staged; the loader selects the single member whose path contains this substring and fails loud if none matches.

file_format.description: Explicit declaration of the on-disk data format of the file that will be staged. Required on every non-derived entry; forbidden on Class C derived entries. zip_containing_icd10cm_order selects a member (via archive_member) from the CMS ICD-10-CM tabular-order zip and parses its header-less fixed-width columns into order_number, icd10_code, header_flag, record_type, short_description and long_description.

staging_name.description: Fully qualified staging collection name in DB.coll form. Runtime appends _v_{data_version}. MUST NOT carry a version suffix here.

public_data_name.description: Fully qualified public-data collection name in DB.coll form. Runtime appends _v_{data_version}. MUST NOT carry a version suffix here.

depends_on.description: Direct upstream source_name lineage for a Class C derived entry. Each string MUST match another entry's source_name in the same dataset_versions array; the registry enforces resolvability and acyclicity at load time. Forbidden on Class A / Class B-owner / Class B-extractor entries.

oneOf.title: Class B-owner - bundled source that owns the archive fetch
Class B-extractor - bundled source that reuses another entry's fetch

allOf.title: source_encoding is permitted only on a plain-text file_format
allOf.description: Charset transcoding is a text-only concern. If the fetch block declares source_encoding, the entry's file_format MUST be a plain-text delimited format; binary artifacts (xlsx, any zip_* including zip_containing_icd10cm_order) are never transcoded at fetch and MUST NOT carry source_encoding.

number_of_days.description: TTL guidance for the source. Ignored when always_refetch is true.

always_refetch.description: When true, the freshness gate skips the HEAD/ETag probe and always fetches. Correct for small ChatHealthy-hosted proprietary files where Cloudflare edge cache can mask fresh origin updates.

report_cap_per_class.description: Max instances of any one finding class the report lists before summarizing.

business_record_keys.description: Per production artifact, the record field that identifies one business record.

finding_types.description: Every finding class the pipeline may emit, mapped to its severity and escalation.

fatal_at_count.description: Occurrence count at which this class escalates to fatal; null = never on volume.

subscribers_secret.description: Name of the Key Vault secret whose value is the report recipient list. Never a value.
